keywords: Can an objection be taken by the Respondent to an application made to Court by the competent authority under section 5(1) that the land is not State Land within the meaning of the State Land (Recovery of Possession) Act No. 07 of 1979(the Act)-Defence available to a person on whom summons under section 6 of the Act has been served-Only Defence available being that such a person noticed is in possession or occupation of the land upon a valid permit or other written authority of the State granted in accordance with any written law and that such permit or authority is in force and not revoked or otherwise rendered invalid.
legistation: Article 138, Article 154P(3)(b) and Article 154P(6) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, State Land (Recovery of Possession) Act No. 07 1979 (as amended), Sections 3, 4, 5(1), 6, 7, 8, 9(1), 9(2) and 10.
